LanguageData.APM_DynamoPoweredGenerator.label: Dynamo powered generator
LanguageData.APM_DynamoPoweredGenerator.description: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Must be periodically refueled by hand.
LanguageData.APM_GazerBeam.label: Gazer Emplacement
LanguageData.APM_GazerBeam.description: The grazer emplacement is mainly composed of the primary ocular beam emitter of a Gazer mechanoid ripped off and attached to a reinforced metal base. While extremely inefficient, it can emit a massive beam of energy in a single direction, destroying foe and fortification alike in its path. It is not capable of moving in any direction.
